alt: Chromatic-aberration glitch effect on the AWS logo — the lowercase 'aws' lettering appears with yellow and blue colour-channel offsets against a dark grey background, with the familiar Amazon orange arrow-smile beneath
story: Amazon Web Services' billing system confused gigabytes with bytes on July 17, 2026 — a 1-billion-fold unit conversion error — sending customers estimated bills as high as $7.1 trillion for accounts that normally owe pennies; AWS acknowledged the bug on social media with: 'Typo alert: Slight miscalculation on our end (very slight)'
why_funny: The company trusted with running roughly a third of the internet's infrastructure made a CS101 bytes-vs-gigabytes mistake and invoiced one customer for more than twice Amazon's entire market cap.
